umf.metamodel.coverage: Current core language objects, properties and conceptual references. Bootstrap JSON Schema and semantic validators remain authoritative; no native enforcement or complete instance validator is generated from this model.

schema.$comment: Exact endpoint/key resolution, unique IDs/names, inverse collisions, multiplicity bounds and lifecycle coherence require portable semantic validation.

cardinality.description: One ideal value, finite ordered sequence with duplicates allowed, finite exact string-key mapping with unique keys, or no assertion. Unknown labels remain uninterpreted.

kind.description: UMF role; unknown labels remain uninterpreted. Missing is unspecified, never inferred from scalarType.

nullability.description: Ideal value availability. Unknown labels remain uninterpreted. Missing and unspecified assert no availability constraint. Native absence carriers require explicit bindings.

facets.description: Missing members impose no bound. Unknown members and qualifiers are retained without interpretation.

integerWidth.description: Signed [-2^(bits-1),2^(bits-1)-1] or unsigned [0,2^bits-1]; mathematical domain, not a physical storage-width assertion.

precision.description: Decimal coefficient digit bound; requires scale. Absolute coefficient is less than 10^precision. No implicit rounding.

scale.description: Fixed fractional digit count; requires precision. Semantic validation requires scale <= precision. Value equals integer coefficient times 10^-scale.

knownScalarType.description: Version-qualified value families; bits128 and uuid have intrinsic16-byte domains under umf-128/1; native refinements remain attached.

anyOf.description: Unknown family retained with incomplete semantic validation.

schema.description: Explicit semantic references compose with unchanged core0.9 UUID/128-bit domains; no external term or native enforcement inferred.
schema.title: UMF 0.10.0 semantic references over exact 128-bit and UUID values
